collection.title: Sky Blue Clothing & Accessories Collection
collection.body_html:
Sky Blue Collection

Our sky blue collection features carefully selected products in soft, powder blue tones that capture the tranquility of a clear summer sky. This versatile shade works across seasons and styles, offering a fresh alternative to traditional navy or royal blue.

About Sky Blue

Sky blue sits between baby blue and cerulean on the color spectrum, characterized by its light, airy quality with RGB values typically around (135, 206, 235). This shade pairs exceptionally well with white, cream, coral, and neutral tones, making it a staple for both casual and refined wardrobes.

Styling Sky Blue

Sky blue works as both a statement piece and a subtle accent. Layer sky blue tops with denim for a tonal look, or pair with khaki and tan for classic spring styling. The color photographs particularly well, making it popular for special occasions and everyday wear alike.

Color Specifications

  • Hex Code: #87CEEB
  • RGB: 135, 206, 235
  • CMYK: 43, 12, 0, 8
  • Pantone Equivalent: 2905 C

All products in this collection feature sky blue as the primary or accent color, carefully selected for color accuracy and quality.
